cue.label: intro-vo
cue.voice: Watch this. I write a few lines of VideoML, and Babulus turns them into a fully timed video—voiceover, motion, and layout all synchronized.

cue.label: layouts-vo
cue.voice: Babulus ships a library of off-the-shelf layouts you can drop in instantly—then move on.

cue.label: code-vo
cue.voice: Voiceover comes straight from this file. Babulus generates audio using pluggable providers like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, and AWS Polly, then computes cue timing from the real clip durations. Add a few words and it regenerates the voice and retimes every scene so everything stays perfectly in sync.
